title: Insert Row Above (Tables)

scenarios.title: Insert Row Above applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: Insert Row Above (BtnInsertRowTop) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.

scenarios.title: BtnInsertRowTop deterministic Office leg

requirements.text: In an isolated real PowerPoint host, the deployed command inserts one row above the selected cell of a fixture 3x3 table whose interior cell (2,2) is selected: the table gains exactly one row, the other axis keeps its geometry, the untouched rows/columns keep their 50/100 pt sizes, the table position stays, the original cell texts shift past the insertion point, the new row starts empty, the feature reports execution, writes no new error-log entry, and tears down cleanly.

scenarios.expected: In an isolated real PowerPoint host, the deployed command inserts one row above the selected cell of a fixture 3x3 table whose interior cell (2,2) is selected: the table gains exactly one row, the other axis keeps its geometry, the untouched rows/columns keep their 50/100 pt sizes, the table position stays, the original cell texts shift past the insertion point, the new row starts empty, the feature reports execution, writes no new error-log entry, and tears down cleanly.

done.statement: The deterministic Office leg passes against the configured build on an isolated PowerPoint host with zero new error-log entries and full teardown; bind-office-evidence-and-reviews remains until this office scenario has real-host evidence and review.
